test_sql_observer_started_event: test the SqlObserver started_event to create a Run, Host, and Experiment record in the database
test_sql_observer_heartbeat_event: test the SqlObserver heartbeat_event to update run info, captured output, and result values
test_sql_observer_completed_event: test the SqlObserver completed_event to set stop_time, result, and COMPLETED status on a run
test_sql_observer_failed_event: test the SqlObserver failed_event to record fail_time, fail_trace, and FAILED status on a run
test_sql_observer_artifact_event: test the SqlObserver artifact_event to attach an artifact file to a run record
